description: Captured Gemini prediction-market ladder events. The default snapshot for an asset is chosen by the ladder service: among snapshots that have not expired, the one with the most two-sided rungs, then the later expiry; when all have expired, the first listed here. referenceSpot is the asset's spot at capture time; when spotIsEstimated is true it was not observed but estimated as the strike where the mid-implied survival crosses 0.5 (linear interpolation between adjacent two-sided rungs).
